plugin.name: themed-decoration
plugin._long: Window frames drawn from a theme directory. Looks come from the theme; the options here are behaviour only.

option.name: theme
option._long: Full path of the theme directory to use. It must contain a theme.toml; see docs/themes/.

option.name: button_order
option._long: Which window buttons to show, from left to right: any of close, minimize, maximize.

option.name: button_side
option._long: Which end of the title bar the buttons sit at: left or right.

option.name: title_double_click
option._short: Double press on the title bar
option._long: What pressing a window's title bar twice in quick succession does: maximize (and back), minimize, or none.

option.name: resize_grip
option._long: How far outside a window's edge a press still takes hold of the edge to resize it. Below 0 for the theme's own value.

option.name: ignore_views
option._short: Decoration disabled for specified window types
option._long: Disables window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria.

option.name: joined_views
option._short: Windows whose tool bar joins the title bar
option._long: Windows matching these criteria have a tool bar of their own directly under the title bar; the title bar then takes the theme's joined look, so that the two look like one piece.

option.name: forced_views
option._short: Force decorations for specified window types
option._long: Forces window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria, overriding client decoration preference.
